description: This script manages the review lifecycle for components based on their metadata.yaml files. It provides commands to start, stop, and clear review cycles, updating lifecycle dates like review_started, review_deadline, and target_green_date. It also references auxiliary scripts and YAML files for component metadata.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds and lists components by locating metadata.yaml files across the repository excluding certain paths.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the full path to a component's metadata.yaml file.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a date after adding a specified number of business days, skipping weekends.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Resets the review lifecycle date fields in a metadata.yaml file to placeholders.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Calls an external script to regenerate the RAG report after updates.
